questions.question: Which land of whirring wings is addressed in Isaiah 18?
options: Egypt (along the banks of the Nile)
Assyria (in the land of the north)

questions.question: What does the LORD say he will do while watching from his dwelling?
options: Send his angels at once to strike the land
Raise up a great storm to scatter all the nations
Wait quietly, like clear heat or a cloud of dew
Call his people to march out to war
questions.answer: Wait quietly, like clear heat or a cloud of dew

questions.question: Isaiah 18 ends with a tribute being brought to the LORD of hosts at Mount Zion.
At that time tribute will be brought to the LORD of hosts to Mount _____.
Ah, land of whirring _____, which is beyond the rivers of Cush.
